# jpa-spring

Spring Boot + Spring Data JPA clinic. Exercises Spring's snake_case naming, `@MappedSuperclass` inheritance, `@Embedded` flattening,
`@ManyToOne`/`@ManyToMany`/`@OneToMany(mappedBy)`, Bean Validation constraints, a Flyway migration merged with its entity,
repository access through Lombok constructor injection, custom `@Query` / `@Modifying` methods, and an enum lifecycle
changed through setters with thrown guards.
